results.title: Festa de Santo António 2026 - Lisbon's Biggest Festival
results.snippet: Annual celebration on June 12-13, 2026. Parades, street parties, grilled sardines, and traditional music fill the Alfama district.

results.title: Lisbon Fish & Flavours Festival - June 2026
results.snippet: Culinary festival from June 18-21, 2026 at Parque das Nações. Celebrity chefs, seafood tastings, and cooking workshops.

results.title: Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026
results.snippet: Major music festival June 20-21 and 27-28, 2026. International and Portuguese artists at Parque da Bela Vista.

results.title: Festas de Lisboa - Month-Long Celebration
results.snippet: Throughout June 2026, Lisbon celebrates its patron saints with neighborhood parties, live music, and traditional food across the city.
